correctness.rationale: For balanced folds, summing squared held-out errors within each fold cancels the within-fold cross term and yields the deterministic identity \(n\widehat R_K=W+K^2B/(K-1)^2\), with W and B the within- and between-fold sums of squares. Under Gaussian sampling, the standard orthogonal one-way ANOVA decomposition gives independent \(W/\sigma^2\sim\chi^2_{n-K}\) and \(B/\sigma^2\sim\chi^2_{K-1}\). Taking moments gives the stated expectation and variance. Fresh symbolic differentiation verifies \(d[n-K+K^4/(K-1)^3]/dK=-(6K^2-4K+1)/(K-1)^4<0\) for K>1. The inspected exact-rational verifier independently checks the deterministic decomposition and algebra on many balanced designs.

value.rationale: Fold-error dependence and the effect of K on cross-validation variability are recurring methodological questions. In the canonical Gaussian location model, the exact score law and strict decrease of its true sampling variance with K cleanly separate dependence-induced failure of naive standard errors from the different question of whether more folds increase the score's variance. This is a motivated finite-sample benchmark rather than an arbitrary calculation.
residual_risks: The model is intentionally elementary, so the result should be interpreted as a benchmark rather than a general CV theorem.

limitations: iid Gaussian location model, balanced fixed folds, sample-mean predictor and squared loss only.
